paragraphs.text: Saved investigations appear here with their findings, citations and sources. Request new research in Chat; it runs only when available and permitted for that conversation.
Research starts in Chat when current permissions and research services allow it. Saved runs share this history, including their searches, sources and validated findings.
Each run is bounded in time, searches, and reads. Sparse verified truth beats polished guessing: a finding only appears when a real, openable source stands behind it.
